collected: 2026-10-20, from the build records named in each step. Every number is as a record gives it; a sum is over per-call or per-shard records. Nothing is estimated. Money is not given.

seconds_kinds.summed_per_call: the seconds of each call added up (calls ran side by side, so this is more than the time it took)
seconds_kinds.elapsed: start to end of the step as its record gives it
seconds_kinds.tool_span: start to end of the command that ran the step, from the session transcript; it includes the step's backup and check

steps.what: the HERB corpus cut into chunks deterministically (v1 chunker) and written to Neo4j; 5,843 chunks written, 4,869 of them kept in this graph (the 974 question, unanswerable and profile chunks dropped on 2026-05-19)
steps.not_recorded: the elapsed time of the chunking and the load, and the machine

steps.what: tagging run pilot_full_herb: per chunk a description and its tags (pass extract), then five facet scores per tag (pass score_tags, later replaced by the facet layer), then per file a description and a relevance score per chunk

extract.in_the_graph: the tags; the description as its vector (step embeddings)

score_tags.in_the_graph: no: the facet values were replaced by the facet layer

steps.what: the four facet values (temporal, why, activity, concreteness) on the 61,018 tag-to-chunk edges: pairs judged by Opus, an encoder cache of every edge, a head fitted on the judged pairs, every edge scored, 24 bootstrap refits whose mean is the stored value and whose agreement gives each facet's range; topic is the cosine of the tag and the description vectors, computed at the write
